title: Analog Canvas
deleteReferenced: {count} note block(s) reference it; the images stay, but can no longer be re-opened from the note.
unsupportedAction: This action is not supported yet
loadFailed: Failed to load. Check that the plugin files are complete.
insertModeHint: Image mode: click "Insert into note" in the editor; the image is stored as a note attachment at the /ac insertion point.
exportDirPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the last system location
defaultExportDirHint: Exporting PNG/SVG opens a save dialog that starts in this folder. Choosing a folder is available on desktop only.
projectStorageHint: Project sources and version snapshots are stored in assets/analog-canvas
imageUpdated: Note image updated (reopen the note if it still looks stale)
imageSaved: Image saved; use /ac in a note to insert it
imageFormatMismatch: The note image is {ext}; export the same format, or delete the old image first.
noInsertTarget: No insertion point found. Use /ac from a note and try again.
openInEditorHint: The circuit is already open in the editor; use File → Export → PNG to insert it.
closeEditorFirst: Close the editor for this circuit before renaming it.
templateHint: Start from a common circuit; every template stays fully editable.
templateLoadFailed: Could not load circuit templates; check that the plugin files are complete.
exportScaleHint: Raster scale for note images and PNG exports; 3× is a good default for print and zooming.
autosaveHint: Save the project every 15 seconds while the editor is open; closing a tab still checks for unsaved changes.
historyLimitHint: The previous version is kept in assets/analog-canvas/.history before each save. Open Version history from a circuit's context menu to view and restore snapshots.
unsavedMessage: "{name}" has unsaved changes. Save before closing?
saveFailed: Could not save; check the file permissions and try again
copyFailed: Copy failed; export the image format first
closeEditorForRestore: Close the editor before restoring a version.
historyHint: The previous version is kept before each save. Close this circuit's editor before restoring.
noHistory: No history yet; save the project once more to create the first snapshot.
confirmRestore: Restore the version from {time}? The current content is saved as a snapshot first.
galleryHint: The Gallery requires sign-in. Open a circuit, press Ctrl/Cmd+A then Ctrl/Cmd+C on the canvas; back in the circuit editor click Insert circuit (or press Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V), then click the canvas to place it.
galleryExternalFailed: Could not open a browser window; visit analog-canvas.tokenzhang.com manually.
gallerySettingsHint: Sign in to browse community circuits. Copy a circuit on the online canvas, then click Insert circuit in the circuit editor to place it here.
insertCircuitClipboardHint: Insert a circuit copied from the online gallery
clipboardNoCircuit: No circuit in the clipboard. Copy one in the online gallery first.
clipboardInserted: Circuit loaded: click the canvas to place it, Esc cancels
clipboardInsertFailed: Could not insert automatically; press Ctrl/Cmd+V on the canvas
importProjectHint: Supports .icproj.json files exported from the online gallery
invalidProjectFile: Not a valid Analog Canvas project file
